The patient has a 5-week history of right facial paresis, facial numbness, and maxillary nerve hypoesthesia, which are consistent with a cranial nerve palsy.
The patient has poorly controlled diabetes mellitus and maxillary nerve hypoesthesia, which are consistent with a diagnosis of diabetic neuropathy.
The patient has hypothyroidism and maxillary nerve hypoesthesia, which are consistent with a diagnosis of hypothyroidism-related neuropathy.
The patient has cultures growing coagulase-negative Staphylococcus aureus, indicating a diagnosis of coagulase-negative Staphylococcus aureus infection.
The patient has cultures growing Enterococcus faecalis, indicating a diagnosis of Enterococcus faecalis infection.
The patient has findings of chronic inflammation and fibropurulent exudate, indicating a diagnosis of chronic inflammation.
